subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They learned that digital life is not automatically permanent.”?
options: Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
If people want future readers to understand today's online world, someone must save it before links break and pages vanish.
A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think the center is.
